ctx.x: So this was after it was redone. After it was all redone from the nightclub. And they used to have this road coming down there. And they had guys from the two bits club and from the honeysuckle inn. They had these lanterns. Lans. Kerosene lanterns. You know like a railroad lantern like that. You could swing it like that. And they're flagging you in for the white picture. And they're flagging you in. And they're flagging you in to come to their place. Well, if the honeysuckle inn was first and the band would…

They all asked for you. Yeah, yeah, yeah. The cow's ass, the chicken's ass. And by the minute the automobile passed by the honeysuckle inn to go over to the two bits club. And they'd go over to the two bits club. Stop. And if somebody would come in there, if they were the first couple to come in there after the air and all this stuff, they'd walk in there and the place is empty and nothing's happening. And they couldn't figure it out.
